config.opencodePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the opencode **v2** executable. Leave empty to search `PATH` for `opencode2`, then `opencode`. On Windows an npm shim (`opencode.cmd`) is accepted and the executable it wraps is launched. Not used while `#openVsCode.serverUrl#` is set. A change applies without reloading the window.
config.serverUrl.patternErrorMessage: Write the address of a server on this machine, like http://127.0.0.1:4096.
config.serverUrl.markdownDescription: Address of an opencode **v2** server that is already running on **this machine**, for example `http://127.0.0.1:4096` (`127.0.0.1`, `[::1]` and `localhost` are accepted, over `http` or `https`). When set, the extension does **not** launch its own server and `#openVsCode.opencodePath#` is not used. Its password is not a setting: run **OpenCode: Set Server Password** (the user is always `opencode`). Leave empty to let the extension launch its own server.
config.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model that every **new** chat session starts with, written `provider/model` (for example `opencode/big-pickle`). It wins over the last model you sent a prompt with. Leave empty to start with that last model, or with opencode's own default if there is none. A value that is badly written or not offered by the server is ignored with a warning.
config.chatLocation.enumDescriptions.sid: Side bar: one chat in the OpenCode view.
config.chatLocation.enumDescriptions.edi: Editor tabs: one tab per session; the Sessions view lists the sessions of the folder.
config.chatLocation.markdownDescription: Where the chat lives. **editor** (the default) opens one editor tab per session and replaces the chat in the OpenCode view with a Sessions view that lists the sessions of the folder; click one to open it in a tab. **sidebar** keeps one chat in the OpenCode view. Any other value counts as **editor**. A change applies at once, without reloading the window. Reload Window restores the open tabs.
config.autoStart.markdownDescription: Launch the opencode server when the window starts. Turn it off to keep the window from launching a server by itself: the chat shows **not started**, and **OpenCode: Restart Server**, the Start button or your first prompt starts it. Has no effect while `#openVsCode.serverUrl#` is set. Turning it back on starts the server at once.
config.mods.enabled.markdownDescription: Load the **mods** found in the OpenCode mods folder (**OpenCode: Open Mods Folder**). A mod is JavaScript that runs with your user's permissions, in its own worker thread: it is **not** sandboxed. Turn this off to load none. Only you can change it: a workspace cannot. Takes effect at once, without reloading the window.
